g.text: Monthly mean of daily sensor means. Light grey cells = no data that month (18 depth-months).
Water temperature by depth, Birchy Head, Nova Scotia, Feb 2018 – Dec 2025
Every depth warms in summer and cools in winter, but the swing shrinks with depth: the average seasonal range is 15 °C at 2 m (peak in September) versus 7 °C at 40 m (peak in October).
Data: Centre for Marine Applied Research (CMAR) Coastal Monitoring Program, via TidyTuesday 2026-03-31.
